queue.title: Transparent Procurement and Verifiable Criteria
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses transparent procurement, key criteria, and practical consequences for companies and bidders.

Transparent procurement is built on predefined criteria, comparable bids, and documented reasoning for the chosen option.

Transparent procurement is built on predefined criteria, comparable bids, and documented reasoning for the chosen option.

The biggest procurement risk arises when criteria only become clear after bids have been received.

Comparability requires equal technical, financial, and contractual assumptions for all bidders.

Documented reasoning protects the process, eases oversight, and improves future decisions.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/transparent-procurement-and-verifiable-criteria/

queue.title: Data Governance for Responsible AI
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses data governance for AI, key requirements, and practical consequences for companies deploying models.

Responsible artificial intelligence starts with clear data provenance, quality control, and measurable accountability for model decisions.

Responsible artificial intelligence starts with clear data provenance, quality control, and measurable accountability for model decisions.

An organisation must know who owns a dataset, how the data changes, and under what conditions it may be used.

Data governance turns responsible AI from a principle into a verifiable operational process.

queue.title: Managing Model Risk in Business Decisions
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses model risk, key controls, and practical consequences for companies relying on analytical models.

Models assist decision-making, but require limits, independent review, and a clear process for when results diverge from reality.

Models assist decision-making, but require limits, independent review, and a clear process for when results diverge from reality.

Every model simplifies reality and therefore carries the risk of a wrong assumption or wrong application.

Model control includes documented inputs, versions, warning thresholds, and independent validation.

A model's output should be an input to a decision, not a substitute for responsible human judgment.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/managing-model-risk-in-business-decisions/
